purpose: Compile JANUS C025 proof search and exact verification into a deterministic, fail-closed execution discipline suitable for a RAD750-class PowerPC 750 target without allowing hardware details to change mathematical admission.

architecture.value: licensed radiation-hardened version of IBM PowerPC 750

mission_confirmation.Perseverance: NASA states its Rover Compute Elements use radiation-hardened BAE RAD750 PowerPC 750 processors operating up to 200 MHz; redundant rover computers are used.
mission_confirmation.Curiosity: NASA states its rover computers use BAE RAD750 PowerPC 750 processors operating up to 200 MHz.

RAD750_is_SOI.reason: Current BAE public component datasheet specifies radiation-hardened bulk CMOS for both 0.25 um and 0.15 um variants.

all_internal_RAD750_registers_are_TMR.reason: Do not transfer TMR details from other rad-hard processors to RAD750 without a RAD750-specific primary source.

every_RAD750_computation_is_majority_vot.reason: Radiation hardening and board-level ECC/redundancy must not be paraphrased as universal per-operation TMR without evidence.

RAD750_L1_is_ECC.reason: Board memory ECC and processor-cache protection are distinct claims; this profile does not conflate them.

RAD750_flight_kernel_policy.word_model: 32-bit integer words for proof state and bitsets
RAD750_flight_kernel_policy.canonical_serialization_byte_order: big-endian network order, independent of host CPU mode
RAD750_flight_kernel_policy.heap_policy: prefer preallocated arenas and bounded scratch regions
RAD750_flight_kernel_policy.hot_cache_target_rationale: Software target reserves approximately one quarter of each 32 KiB L1 cache for stack, metadata, conflict effects and runtime overhead; this is a JANUS policy, not a RAD750 hardware guarantee.
RAD750_flight_kernel_policy.checkpoint_digest: SHA-256 in reference implementation; flight implementation may use a separately validated implementation but digest identity must match canonical bytes
RAD750_flight_kernel_policy.watchdog_epoch: Every bounded proof-search epoch must have a predeclared work budget and terminate in VERIFIED_PROGRESS, VERIFIED_TERMINAL, OPEN_BUDGET, or SAFE_ERROR.
RAD750_flight_kernel_policy.fault_response: Never invent or repair a mathematical result after an integrity mismatch; replay from the last verified checkpoint or return OPEN/SAFE_ERROR.

redundancy_without_false_TMR_claim.proposal_channel: may be single, replicated, heuristic, learned or host-assisted
redundancy_without_false_TMR_claim.verification_channel_B: independently implemented verifier with the same formal transition contract
redundancy_without_false_TMR_claim.acceptance: A semantic transition is admitted only if both verifiers agree on canonical before/after fingerprints and certificate validity.
redundancy_without_false_TMR_claim.optional_third_replay: May be used for fault localization, but 2-of-3 voting must never override a formally invalid certificate.
redundancy_without_false_TMR_claim.common_mode_warning: Software replication does not eliminate common-mode specification or implementation bugs.

resource_separation.semantic_cap: Frozen theorem-side N^C bound measured from the root input; hardware cannot relax it.
resource_separation.hardware_working_set: RAD750 scheduling/chunking target; may split a certified operation into bounded deterministic passes without changing the mathematical object.
resource_separation.time_budget: Reported separately from semantic state size and certificate bytes.
resource_separation.memory_budget: Reported separately for L1-hot scratch, external RAM state, certificate storage and checkpoint storage.

portable_algorithmic_speedup_interpretat.correct: If JANUS eventually finds a genuinely better exact algorithm with a proved polynomial bound, that algorithmic advantage is in principle portable across general-purpose machines capable of implementing the operations.
portable_algorithmic_speedup_interpretat.incorrect: The algorithm does not increase the RAD750 clock rate, MIPS rating, cache size, radiation hardness, or physically boost arbitrary processors.
portable_algorithmic_speedup_interpretat.practical_caveat: Constant factors, memory bandwidth, compiler quality, word size, cache behavior and available RAM can dominate finite instances even when asymptotic complexity is better.

implementation_order: Emit a deterministic flight manifest from every proof ledger.
Implement a small integer-only reference verifier suitable for C/PowerPC 750 porting.
Add independent verifier diversity and checkpoint replay.
Only after semantic CI passes, tune data layout and instruction scheduling for PowerPC 750 caches/pipelines.
